lines: Lofted body through 3 sections: Ø80 mm circular section → Ø64.2 mm circular section → 48.3 × 48.3 mm rectangular section.
8-sided polygon section, 35.2 mm across corners attachment, 31.1 mm long, from top face with a Ø14.3 mm bore.
dimensions.text: Lofted body through 3 sections: Ø80 mm circular section → Ø64.2 mm circular section → 48.3 × 48.3 mm rectangular section. 8-sided polygon section, 35.2 mm across corners attachment, 31.1 mm long, from top face with a Ø14.3 mm bore. Chamfer 1.2 mm on top edges.
